faq_heading: 3 bedroom condos in Langley: your questions answered

faq.q: What do 3 bedroom condos sell for in Langley?
faq.a: Of the 3 bedroom condos in Langley, 71 sold over the past year at a median of $678,500, with the middle half between $639,900 and $761,950.

faq.q: How fast do 3 bedroom condos sell in Langley?
faq.a: The median was 26 days, and homes sold for 97.8% of the list price at a median.

faq.q: Where in Langley do most 3 bedroom condos sell?
faq.a: Willoughby Heights, with 51 of the 71 sales at a median of $690,000.

faq.q: Which buildings in Langley have 3 bedroom condos for sale most often?
faq.a: By sales over the past year: Yorkson Park (4 sales); Aristotle (4 sales); Walnut Park (3 sales).

faq.q: What is the strata fee on a 3 bedroom condo in Langley?
faq.a: The median strata fee on the 3 bedroom condos that sold in Langley was $483 a month. Fees vary by building, so check the building's own figure.
